trials.claim: Starter plan provides lifetime access to AnyChat
trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to AnyChat
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future plan updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms let the vendor modify, discontinue, or terminate the service at any time without notice, materially limiting the lifetime-access promise despite one positive review.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right at any time to modify or discontinue the Service (or any part or content thereof) without notice at any time.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can discontinue the service at any time without notice, which voids any promise of lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: we also may terminate this agreement at any time without notice and you will remain liable for all amounts due up to and including the date of termination
exhibits.argument: Vendor can terminate the agreement and deny access at any time, contradicting guaranteed lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: they genuinely respect the meaning of “lifetime”, keep updating the platform, and show a real commitment to their users.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms vendor honors lifetime meaning and keeps updating the platform.
